# Bad Traits Examples
# Demonstrates CK3800 (and reserved CK3801-CK3804)

namespace = traits_bad

# ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait referenced — common misspellings
traits_bad.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = traits_bad.0001.t
	desc = traits_bad.0001.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		has_trait = proud # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "proud"
		# Should have: has_trait = arrogant
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
	}

	option = {
		name = traits_bad.0001.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3800: Wrong depressed trait name
traits_bad.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = traits_bad.0002.t
	desc = traits_bad.0002.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		has_trait = depressed # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "depressed"
		# Should have: has_trait = depressed_1
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
	}

	option = {
		name = traits_bad.0002.a
		remove_trait = depressed # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "depressed"
		# Should have: remove_trait = depressed_1
		add_piety = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3800: Wrong beauty trait naming
traits_bad.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = traits_bad.0003.t
	desc = traits_bad.0003.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		has_trait = beauty_1 # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "beauty_1"
		# Should have: has_trait = beauty_good_1
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
	}

	option = {
		name = traits_bad.0003.a
		add_prestige = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3800: add_trait with nonexistent trait
traits_bad.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = traits_bad.0004.t
	desc = traits_bad.0004.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
	}

	option = {
		name = traits_bad.0004.a
		add_trait = heroic # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "heroic"
		# Should have: add_trait = brave
		add_prestige = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3800: Multiple wrong trait names in one event
traits_bad.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = traits_bad.0005.t
	desc = traits_bad.0005.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		has_trait = cowardly # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "cowardly"
		# Should have: has_trait = craven
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
	}

	option = {
		name = traits_bad.0005.a
		remove_trait = cowardly # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "cowardly"
		# Should have: remove_trait = craven
		add_trait = courageous # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "courageous"
		# Should have: add_trait = brave
		add_prestige = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3800: Edge cases — similar-sounding traits
traits_bad.0006 = {
	type = character_event
	title = traits_bad.0006.t
	desc = traits_bad.0006.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		OR = {
			has_trait = stressed # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "stressed"
			# Should have: has_trait = stressed_1
			has_trait = wounded # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "wounded"
			# Should have: has_trait = wounded_1
			has_trait = ugly # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "ugly"
			# Should have: has_trait = beauty_bad_1
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
	}

	option = {
		name = traits_bad.0006.a
		add_gold = 50
	}
}

# =====================================================================
# Reserved diagnostic codes — not currently emitted
# These blocks document future validation rules
# =====================================================================

# CK3801 (reserved for future validation): Incompatible traits coexist
# Example: brave and craven are opposites and should not coexist
# traits_bad.reserved_0801 = {
#     trigger = {
#         has_trait = brave
#         has_trait = craven  # Would flag: incompatible traits
#     }
#     option = {
#         add_trait = lustful
#         add_trait = chaste  # Would flag: incompatible traits
#     }
# }

# CK3802 (reserved for future validation): Duplicate trait definition
# Example: defining the same trait twice in common/traits/
# my_custom_trait = { ... }
# my_custom_trait = { ... }  # Would flag: duplicate definition

# CK3803 (reserved for future validation): Missing trait opposite
# Example: a trait defined with opposite = missing_trait where missing_trait doesn't exist
# my_trait = {
#     opposite = nonexistent_trait  # Would flag: opposite not defined
# }

# CK3804 (reserved for future validation): Invalid trait group
# Example: a trait assigned to a group that doesn't exist
# my_trait = {
#     group = nonexistent_group  # Would flag: unknown trait group
# }

# All errors combined
traits_bad_all_errors = {
	type = character_event
	title = traits_bad_all_errors.t
	desc = traits_bad_all_errors.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		has_trait = proud # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "proud"
		has_trait = depressed # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "depressed"
		has_trait = beauty_1 # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "beauty_1"
	}

	immediate = {
		save_scope_as = actor
	}

	option = {
		name = traits_bad_all_errors.a
		remove_trait = cowardly # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "cowardly"
		add_trait = heroic # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "heroic"
		add_prestige = 100
	}

	option = {
		name = traits_bad_all_errors.b
		add_trait = ugly # ERROR CK3800: Unknown trait: "ugly"
		# Should have: add_trait = beauty_bad_1
		add_gold = 50
	}
}
